title: b7z9.16(a): wire DAO timing into Rust RplStack TX path
description: Parent: project-LICHEN-worker6-b7z9.16 (spec 09 14.2 R-09-017..019: initial DAO random 0-2s after joining; retry 4/8/16s exponential backoff; refresh 900s = 30-min soft lifetime / 2). Wire rust/lichen-rpl/src/dao_timing.rs exports (DAO_INITIAL_DELAY_MIN/MAX_MS:9-12, DAO_RETRY_DELAYS_MS=[4000,8000,16000]:15, DAO_REFRESH_INTERVAL_SECONDS=900:27, DaoRetryBackoff:196, DaoRefreshTimer:122) into the rust/lichen-node RplStack DAO TX path (after build_signed_dao / send_dao — find callers via grep). Runtime must: schedule initial DAO 0-2s after DODAG join, drive retries through DaoRetryBackoff, re-emit via DaoRefreshTimer. Keep dao_timing.rs constants/functions as the single oracle — do not duplicate constants. Unit tests: drive the TX path with a fake/controllable clock asserting the three behaviors (exact boundaries from constants). Independently landable; Python and C mirrors are sibling children.
close_reason: Landed by worker-6 (claimed; commits in this round-set): (a) DaoTxScheduler state + join hook (lagn slice, de0a5a970e follow-up commit) and (b) TX-path wiring — RplRuntimeAction::DaoTransmit added to the executor-neutral runtime; RplStack::runtime_poll checks dao_tx_advance first and returns a DaoTransmit action when the scheduler is due (preempting the receive window per R-09-017 initial 0-2s window); runtime_complete_dao_transmit clears the pending action and schedules maintenance. The retry ladder and refresh phases were already driven by the scheduler from (a) via on_dao_failed/on_dao_sent — retry exhaustion maps to Exhausted per R-09-019. dao_timing.rs remains the single oracle. Tests: dao_tx_sched unit tests (5: idle-until-join, initial window, refresh boundary, retry ladder boundaries + exhaustion) and an RplStack runtime integration test (join -> poll returns DaoTransmit -> send_dao -> complete clears pending; next poll OK) — all green: 337/337. Honest gate note: clippy --features std,raw-rpl-test-api --lib -D warnings still fails on the PRE-EXISTING tokio::test dev-dependency feature-gating issue (tokio 'macros' only in dev-deps; E0433 x11) plus two nits now fixed (unused RecipientReplayState import, redundant expiry_unix field). cargo test is the operative gate.
